datasets.name: Loess Plateau dataset
datasets.source: Institute of Remote Sensing and Digital Earth (RADI) under the Chinese Academy of Sciences (CAS)
datasets.verbatim: Old landslide samples were measured in 2018 by the Gaofen-1 satellite, and the dataset were made by the Institute of Remote Sensing and Digital Earth (RADI) under the Chinese Academy of Sciences (CAS).

datasets.name: Bijie dataset
datasets.verbatim: Ji’s team has made this dataset open for the benefits of fellow researchers, including both HRSIs with a resolution of 0.8 m/pixel and DEM data with a resolution of 2 m/pixel [26].

methods.name: FFS-Net (Feature-fusion based semantic segmentation network)
methods.summary: A semantic segmentation network that uses a Siamese network (without weight sharing) to independently extract features from HRSIs and DEM data, which are then fused in a higher feature layer. It incorporates a multiscale channel attention module in the encoder and an improved decoder using transposed convolution, dropout, and batch normalization.
methods.verbatim: In this article, a multiple heterogeneous data FFS-Net was proposed for landslide detection... In the proposed FFS-Net model, a Siamese network without weight sharing was designed to separately extract these two types of features from the HRSIs and DEM data before fusing them.

reproducibility_assessment: The landslide datasets are mentioned but not linked, though they are practically accessible via external repositories. The custom FFS-Net code is not provided or linked.
